script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying Nehemiah isn't planning a trip asserts something the passage doesn't establish.
The report says the wall is broken down and the gates burned. It doesn't say there is no wall or that nothing stands between the city and trouble.
The explanation quotes Nehemiah speaking as “I” without naming him as the speaker first.
Calling the question a trap comments on the lesson's own question.
Nehemiah confesses the sins of the Israelites and his father's house as well as his own, so saying he doesn't point at anybody else is inaccurate.
The verse doesn't identify “this man” as the king. It says Nehemiah was the king's cupbearer.
Mercy is not the whole request. Nehemiah also asks for success and for the Lord to attend to the prayers.
Nehemiah's position as cupbearer does not establish that the king is “this man.”
Calling a baker a “fellow baker” calls Papa Dorin a baker.
The explanation quotes Nehemiah speaking as “I” without naming him as the speaker first.
The passage doesn't say whether Nehemiah is carrying a sword.
